metadata.project: Click Appeal as a Potential Game: Modeling Creator Incentives, Attention Congestion, and Social Welfare in YouTube
metadata.calibration_status: Post-Test Final Full-Sample Calibration (N = 809 videos, G = 38 channels)
metadata.locked_specification: Model 4-Centered: Strategic Payoff Function with Contemporaneous Peer Appeal
metadata.mathematical_note: Uncentered coefficients (b1_u, b2_u, b3_u, b5_u) are analytically derived from the centered model and represent the true structural payoff parameters for uncentered click appeal x in [0, 1] as defined in Eq. 2.

sample_summary.peer_window_description: Contemporaneous rolling 60-day window [t - 30d, t + 30d], LOCO across channels
sample_summary.subscribers_snapshot_note: Subscriber count measured as late-2026 snapshot; acts as time-invariant channel scale control

uncentered_structural_coefficients_for_g.description: Primary parameters for paper Eq. 2: pi_i(x_i, x_bar) = b0_u + b1_u*x_i + b2_u*x_i^2 + b3_u*x_bar + b5_u*x_i*x_bar + controls

centered_estimation_coefficients.description: Econometric estimation model: ln(V) = b0_c + b1_c*(x - mu_x) + b2_c*(x - mu_x)^2 + b3_c*(x_bar - mu_xbar) + b5_c*(x - mu_x)*(x_bar - mu_xbar) + controls

joint_f_test_packaging_terms.interpretation: Packaging terms are jointly insignificant (p = 0.755). Adding packaging terms to creator scale and duration yields essentially zero predictive gain.

test_concavity.interpretation: Concavity is NOT statistically established (p = 0.2600). Point estimate beta_2 < 0 is a calibrated assumption, not an established empirical fact.

game_theoretic_properties.exact_potential_function: Phi(x_1, ..., x_N) = sum_i [ b1_u*x_i + b2_u*x_i^2 ] + [b5_u / (2*(N-1))] * sum_i sum_{j != i} x_i*x_j - sum_i C_i(x_i)

stability_evaluation_option_A_unaugmente.implication: On raw unaugmented point estimates, b5 = 20.794 > 2|b2| = 16.395, so 2|b2| - b5 = -4.399 < 0. Best-response dynamics do NOT form a contraction mapping, and the symmetric interior fixed point is an unstable repeller. Unconstrained best responses diverge to boundaries {0, 1}.

stability_evaluation_option_B_cost_augme.status_of_kappa: ASSUMPTION (NOT estimated from data; added to restore mathematical contraction)
stability_evaluation_option_B_cost_augme.linear_cost_clarification: Linear cost (c_i * x_i) shifts payoff levels and intercepts, but does NOT alter the second derivative or best-response slope. Linear cost CANNOT restore a contraction mapping.
stability_evaluation_option_B_cost_augme.interior_solution_note: Convex cost (kappa > 0) steepens marginal costs and makes an interior equilibrium more likely, but boundary clipping at [0, 1] remains necessary if marginal payoffs remain positive at x = 1.
stability_evaluation_option_B_cost_augme.downstream_replacement_rule: In all paper formulas (x_Nash, x_SO, PoA, G(lambda), lambda_max), replace |b2| with (|b2| + kappa/2).
stability_evaluation_option_B_cost_augme.corrected_poa_definition: PoA = exp[pi(x_SO, x_SO) - pi(x_NE, x_NE)] (evaluating true social welfare difference, NOT potential function ratio Phi_SO / Phi_NE)
